We need parse all 69. Need output exactly 69 objects. Let's go story by story. Need identify extra info beyond role, means, optional ends. Many have typos, duplicate "so that", but that's another criterion? Minimal applies extra info. We need only violation if extra stuff like implementation notes, mock-up details, procedural notes, comments. Role and means and ends. Some stories include long details about required fields, etc. Those violate Minimal. Some include "The following information must be shown..." etc. Others include procedural "as third step", "admin view" maybe not violation? It can be means? Need careful.

QUS Minimal is syntactic: nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. Core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other info external. If story includes extra clauses after ends? For example BC-005: "As a trainer, I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." The phrase "and links to slides" is extra? Maybe means? I want to edit my training node myself and links to slides? It says "so that ... and links to slides." Contains extra object "links to slides" not as ends? likely violation. BC-007: duplicate "so that, so that" and list statuses. Does list "attendend, refunded, no show" as elaborating rationale? It is extra details? Maybe not? It's specifying status values, which is implementation-ish? Need decide.

Let's systematically examine all.

Criterion: Minimal violation when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to story sentence. It says "contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale". So any additional info is violation. But many "so that" rationale can have explanatory reasons "so that I can see WTF is happening" etc. That's ends. Role and means. If it lists fields to show, that is mock-up notes/implementation details. If it says "The following information must be shown: Logo, title..." definitely violation. If it says "so that we don't have duplicate spaces" etc fine. If includes "as third step of registration process" is procedural note? maybe yes; but it is in means "See a payment page ... as third step". Might be extra procedural context. Evidence "and links to slides." Violation.
